title: AlertV1
description: One alert firing, as published on alerts.v1. The message key is the service name. A new required field or a changed meaning is a new topic version (alerts.v2), not an edit here.

event_id.description: Unique per event, set by the producer. Consumers deduplicate on it, so a retried send is harmless.

source.description: The system that raised the alert, e.g. prometheus or the simulator.

service.description: The service the alert is about. Also the message key, so one service's alerts stay in order.

fingerprint.description: Stable for one alert rule on one target: the same problem firing again has the same fingerprint.

occurred_at.description: When the alert fired, with a UTC offset.

labels.description: Free-form key/value labels from the source, e.g. alertname, instance, region.
